tools.name: quick_score
tools.description: Score a video's hook in ~10s — no API key needed. Pass a public https video URL; returns {job_id, status}. Poll get_job_status until status='completed'.

tools.name: analyze_video
tools.description: Full engagement analysis (drop-offs, edit suggestions, best 30s/60s clips, audience reactions). Modes: fast (60s) | deep (5m) | turbo (15s, 1.5× credits). Returns {job_id}.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Poll a job. output_format='agent' returns minimal report (saves ~1850 tokens). When status='completed', read report.agent_instructions.{verdict,edits,clips}. brain_simulation_url (when present) links the predicted Cortex brain-reaction map (literature-grounded, not a brain scan).

tools.name: list_recent_jobs
tools.description: List the API key owner's recent jobs (default 20). Returns job_id, status, viral_score, share_url, created_at for each.

tools.name: share_report
tools.description: Toggle a job's public visibility. is_public=true returns {share_url, og_image_url} the agent can post on social or hand back to the user.

tools.name: export_job
tools.description: Export a job's edit suggestions as an FCPXML timeline file (imports into Final Cut Pro, Premiere, and DaVinci Resolve). Returns the FCPXML document as text.

tools.name: submit_retention_feedback
tools.description: After the user publishes the video, report back actual views / retention so future predictions improve. Free, improves model accuracy.

tools.name: buy_credits
tools.description: Get a Stripe Checkout URL (accepts card / Stripe Link / USDC crypto) so the human can buy 10 credits for $20. Return the URL to the user — agents never see card data.

tools.name: manage_billing
tools.description: Open Stripe Customer Portal — user can manage subscription, payment methods, view invoices. Returns a URL; hand it to the user.

tools.name: create_sub_agent_key
tools.description: Mint a scoped child API key with a credit spend cap (default 100). Use this to delegate to worker agents without sharing your master key.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: One-shot discovery — returns the full Omnicensus tool catalog, modes, platforms, rate limits, share URL template, error codes. ~430 tokens.

tools.name: get_agent_balance
tools.description: Returns the API key's remaining credit balance. Call before buy_credits if you need to warn the user.

tools.name: extract_clips
tools.description: Render 1-5 short vertical clips from a video (1 credit/clip). aspect_ratio: source|9:16|1:1|16:9. Optional caption_language (translates burned captions) and include_broll (Pexels/Pixabay overlays). Applies the API key owner's saved brand kit. Returns {job_id}; poll get_job_status until ready, then read clips[].url.

tools.name: score_hook_variant
tools.description: Predict a candidate hook's viral score (0-100) before reshooting. Free. Returns {predicted_score, current_score, delta, verdict, reasoning} for the given job_id.

tools.name: chat_with_report
tools.description: Ask follow-up questions about an analyzed job's report (1 credit/message, refunded on failure). Pass the full messages[] history; returns {message, chat_id}. mode: report|ideas.

tools.name: explore_audience
tools.description: Re-run analysis against a synthetic audience (free, max 10/hour). Pass demographics (ageGroups, gender, subscribedStatus, countries). Returns {exploration_id, status}.

tools.name: post_clip_to_social
tools.description: Post a rendered clip to connected accounts (youtube_shorts|tiktok|instagram_reels). Free. Account must already be connected in Settings. Returns per-platform {results, clip_url}.

tools.name: schedule_post
tools.description: Queue a future post to connected accounts. Free at schedule time; a cron publishes it when due. scheduled_at is a future unix timestamp in MILLISECONDS. Returns {id, status}.

tools.name: create_org_job
tools.description: Agency/team: analyze a video billed to an ORG credit pool (not personal). Your API key's owner must be a member (owner/admin/editor) of org_id. Deducts from the pool with per-member/client caps. Returns {job_id, credits_charged}; poll get_job_status.

tools.name: get_org_rollup
tools.description: Agency/team roll-up for org_id (member-only): org totals (pooled_credits, members, clients, jobs, spend) + per-client {jobs_count, avg_score, trend, recent}.

tools.name: generate_thumbnails
tools.description: Generate ranked, platform-sized thumbnail candidates for an analyzed job. CV-scored frames (face/sharpness/contrast/colour/title-space) cropped to youtube(1280x720)/short(1080x1920)/square(1080x1080). k=1-5 (default 3). Free. Returns {status, job_id}; poll get_job_status for thumbnails.candidates[].

tools.name: channel_insights
tools.description: Aggregate patterns across recent jobs (default 20, max 50): avg score + trend, hook trend, common drop points (% of video), best-performing length bucket, recurring weak craft dimension, top genres. Personal by default; pass org_id (+optional client_id) for an agency scope (member-only). Free. Honest enough=false under 3 videos. Returns {insights, scope}.

tools.name: competitor_teardown
tools.description: Diff an analysed competitor video against YOUR channel averages (analyze_video the competitor's URL first, then pass its job_id). Returns {teardown:{headline,they_win[],you_win[],parity[],competitor_score,your_avg_score}} — what they do better, where you lead, and parity. Only compares dimensions both sides have. Free. Honest enough=false with no own history.

tools.name: apply_edits
tools.description: Render a downloadable edited cut of an analysed job by removing its 'cut' edit_suggestions (dead zones / low-energy spans). Free. Returns {status, job_id}; poll get_job_status for edited_cut{url, original_duration, edited_duration, removed_seconds, cuts_applied[]}.

tools.name: generate_post_copy
tools.description: Write the post AROUND an analysed video: 3 caption variants + hashtags + a platform-tuned description, grounded ONLY in the real transcript/summary (no invented stats). platform: youtube|youtube_shorts|tiktok|instagram_reels|x. 1 credit (refunded on failure). Returns {captions[3], hashtags, description, disclaimer}.

tools.name: next_video_ideas
tools.description: Plan the NEXT video from the key owner's OWN library: best length, recurring weakness, top genre + 3 LLM concept angles grounded in their top transcripts (not market data). 1 credit, cached per ISO-week (cache hit = free). Honest enough=false under 3 analysed videos. Returns {ideas[3], best_length, recurring_weakness, top_genre}.

tools.name: dub_clip
tools.description: AI-dub one clip of a clip job into another language (es|pt|hi|fr|de|it|ja|ko|ar). Translates the transcript, synthesises a neural voice, ducks the original bed, burns target-language captions. 3 credits/min of clip (refunded on dispatch failure). Returns {status}; poll get_job_status for dubs["{clip_index}_{language}"].url. Output is an AI-dubbed (synthetic) voice — disclose where required.

tools.name: generate_title_package
tools.description: Package an analysed video for publishing: 5 scored title options + SEO tags + an optimized description + hashtags, grounded ONLY in the real transcript/summary (optional target keyword). 1 credit (refunded on failure). Returns {titles[5]{text,score,reason}, tags, description, hashtags}. Pair the titles with generate_thumbnails output.

tools.name: research_niche
tools.description: Real niche/keyword research (NO fabricated search-volume numbers). Pass a query (or a job_id to derive it). Returns {keyword_ideas[] from real YouTube autocomplete demand, videos[] of real top-viewed niche videos with view counts when the owner's YouTube is connected, youtube_connected}. Free. Use to find what's working before planning the next video.

tools.name: share_brain_map
tools.description: Make a job's predicted brain-reaction map public on a token-gated /brain/{token} page (honest 'predicted, not a scan' label). Job must have a brain_simulation_url. Free. Returns {share_url, token}.

tools.name: set_account_profile
tools.description: Set the account type (individual or business/corporate) + profile. A 'business' account unlocks the org/team workflow (create_org_job, get_org_rollup, fund_org_pool). Returns {ok, account_profile}.

tools.name: fund_org_pool
tools.description: Fund an agency org credit pool by CARD via Stripe (owner/admin of org_id only). credits 5-5000 at $2/credit. LIVE BILLING — returns {url} (a Stripe checkout link); the pool is credited after the human completes payment. First top-up saves the card so the pool can auto-recharge.
